project: MCP Bridge – AI-assisted Large File Refactor
goal: Refactor extremely large (500–1000+ lines) html.twig files using a fully tool-driven, reproducible workflow to stress-test primitives, AI steps, diff safety, snapshots, and state tracking.

workflow.name: readFile
workflow.purpose: Load original html.twig file into context

workflow.name: analyzeFile
workflow.purpose: Build structural model (blocks, loops, macros, variables, includes)

workflow.name: analyzeTask
workflow.purpose: Map task requirements to exact file regions and operations (insert / replace / refactor)

workflow.name: generateImprovements
workflow.purpose: Produce improved code fragments and patch instructions

workflow.name: mergePatch
workflow.purpose: Safely apply fragments to base file using diff model

workflow.name: renderPreview
workflow.purpose: Show full rebuilt file or unified diff for human validation

workflow.name: snapshot
workflow.purpose: Store before/after state, task metadata, and transformation history
